text:
Kai: Hey folks — clearing out some desk gear before I move. Up for grabs: 32\" BenQ 4K monitor (PD3200U), Ergotron dual-monitor arm (one base), and a small two-drawer rolling file cabinet. Also have 2x SF Opera matinee tickets (Sun 2pm). Free if you can pickup from SOMA office by Sat noon. Pics: https://imgur.com/benq32op

Tasha: Ooh interested in the monitor. Does it have any dead pixels?

Kai: No dead pixels, screen cleaned last week. Has a few cosmetic scuffs on the back. VESA 100x100.

Miguel: I could use the monitor arm if it's the single-base Ergotron LX. Can pick up Friday after 5pm.

FacilitiesBot: Reminder: pickups after 6pm require a Facilities escort. Book freight elevator if item is bulky. See #eng-infra for reservations.

Tasha: I can pick up Saturday 11am for the monitor. Will DM you for phone number, Kai. Can bring a friend to help carry.

Sam: If the tickets remain, Id love one. Opera matinees are my jam. Are they physical or digital?

Kai: Tickets are PDF barcodes I can email or print and leave at the front desk. I'll label the monitor box \"For Tasha\" and put the arm in locker F. Cabinet I'll leave near loading dock with a note.

Miguel: Perfect — Friday 5:30pm pickup for the arm then. I'll reserve the freight elevator just in case. DMing you now Kai.

Tasha: Claimed the monitor. Thanks Kai! Also bringing a blanket to protect the bezel.

Sam: If there's one ticket left after that, I'll take it. Can pick up Sat morning.

Kai: Nice — I'll leave one ticket at front desk for Sam and email the other to my friend. If plans change I'll update here. :white_check_mark:

Miguel: Thanks, Kai. Will bring tools for the arm install. Appreciate the hookup.

Sam: Got the ticket at front desk this morning, thanks Kai! :opera:

(Reaction: Kai's first message got :package: from Miguel)
